title: A board host that cannot serve yet: the HTTP 503 body (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0098)
description: Answered with HTTP 503 and a Retry-After header, before the host reads the call: while the host's store starts (stack-starting) or after it was lost (stack-unavailable). The caller waits Retry-After seconds and calls again with the same arguments; nothing was stored. It is not a refusal of the call (comms-refusal), and the same for every caller.

error.description: One sentence on what the host waits for; never a path, a secret or a Project.
